_comment: Bild-Manifest für die Design-Reise. Keys = Pfad (repo-root-relativ, exakt wie im node-`image`-Feld). Werte = Motiv-Prompt; das Skript hängt `style` an. Editierbar ohne Code — neue Slots hier eintragen, dann scripts/generate-engine-images.mjs laufen lassen. Datengetrieben (Brief §9).
style: editorial fashion photography, dark moody studio, single-subject, deep matte black background #0a0a0b, soft cinematic rim light, subtle pink-violet-cyan gradient accent, Poppins-clean minimalism, high detail, anti-fast-fashion atelier mood, no text, no logo

images.js/design-engine/content/img/mood/calm-m: a serene monochrome wardrobe still life, muted greys, quiet minimalism, soft folds
images.js/design-engine/content/img/mood/bold-n: a bold expressive garment glowing in neon pink and cyan, high energy, confident
images.js/design-engine/content/img/mood/soft-d: soft fluid fabric draping gently, organic curves, tender couture feel
images.js/design-engine/content/img/mood/sharp-: an architectural structured garment, crisp tailored angles, technical precision
an immaculate clean minimal garment, no pattern, pure surface, calm
